<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Reflective Defense](/Feats.aspx?ID=4327) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=100" />
<trait label="Talos" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=507" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 52

**Frequency**
once per 10 minutes

**Trigger**
A creature within 30 feet of you targets you, and you can see the attacker.

**Requirements**
You are in [dim](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) or [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407).

</column>

---

Your body's natural luster has been polished to a gleaming shine. You use this to reflect light back into your enemy's eyes, disrupting its aim and focus; it must succeed at a Reflex save against your class DC or be [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) until the end of your next turn.
name: Reflective Defense
requirement: You are in  dim  or  bright light .
